- Why PlanQ is new: It uses a stochastic global search directly on the forward model Li(A,B,C,p,q,r,d) rather than solving a fixed algebraic system or relying on deterministic plan-specific derivations. This yields three equations in the three unknowns A,B,C and d (treating p,q,r through their constraints).
